entities.name: Aygün Kazimova
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Aygun Alasgar gyzy Kazimova is an Azerbaijani singer, songwriter, pop musician, and actress in Azerbaijan, Turkey, and Russia. Kazimova wrote and sang the anthem of the 2012 FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup. Her duet with Snoop Dogg "Coffee from Colombia" was a number one hit on the Azerbaijani, Turkish, Czech Republic, Colombian, Georgian and Russian charts. Kazimova has recorded ten albums.
